objective: Gate 4E post-audit READ_ONLY inmediatamente posterior a la migracion universal Gate 4D ejecutada con postcheck PASS en Development. Certificar esquema persistido exacto, FKs/indices trusted, cero seed rows, sin Toast_* nuevos y Production untouched. No DDL/DML ni secretos.

queries.name: gate4e_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login

queries.name: gate4e_new_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate4e_target_columns
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE (o.name='Unidades_Negocio' AND c.name IN ('timezone_iana','locale_operativo')) OR (o.name='Sync_Control_Ejecuciones' AND c.name IN ('ConexionID','UnidadNegocioID','CodigoSync','StartedAtUTC','FinishedAtUTC','IdempotencyKey')) OR (o.name='Servidores_ConexionEstado' AND c.name IN ('UltimaPruebaUTC','UltimoExitoUTC','UltimoErrorUTC','UltimoErrorCodigo','UltimoErrorMensaje','LatenciaMs','UltimoSyncUTC','UltimoSyncExitosoUTC','FechaActualizacionUTC')) ORDER BY o.name,c.name

queries.name: gate4e_named_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.name IN ('FK_Sistema_Sync_Capacidades_Sync','FK_Sistema_Sync_Capacidades_Capacidad','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Conexion','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Unidad','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_CodigoSync','FK_Sync_Control_Evidencias_Ejecucion','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Unidad','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Sistema','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Version','FK_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Conexion') ORDER BY fk.name

queries.name: gate4e_named_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name,i.name,i.is_unique,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.name IN ('UX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_IdempotencyKey','IX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Conexion_CodigoSync','IX_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_UnidadSistema','IX_Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos_Conexion') ORDER BY i.name

queries.name: gate4e_new_table_rows
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,SUM(p.rows) AS row_count FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','Sync_Control_Evidencias','Sistema_IdentificadoresExternos') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate4e_base_objects_preserved
queries.sql: SELECT name,type_desc FROM sys.objects WHERE name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Servidores_Conexiones','Servidores_ConexionEstado','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') ORDER BY name

queries.name: gate4e_no_toast_domain_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE 'Toast[_]%' OR o.name LIKE '%ToastRobot%' OR o.name LIKE '%RobotConnection%') ORDER BY o.name
